skill.name: socialdatax-sensitive-check
skill.description: Send draft text to SocialDataX for a pre-publication review of potentially restricted wording. Choose Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, or general text.
skill.summary: Review draft wording for potential policy risks and get suggested revisions from SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts concern Markdown syntax, documentation links, key names, or ordinary multilingual text. The CLI runs an unpinned package with access to credentials, and the service retains submitted drafts. No evidence of prompt injection, embedded secrets, or deliberate credential theft was found.

remediation.issue: The workflow fetches and runs an unpinned CLI package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited release, verify its integrity, and require approval before installation. Run it with only the credentials and permissions it needs.

remediation.issue: The service retains draft text, but the workflow does not require informed consent before submission.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the recipient, retention, and possible charges before sending text through either route. Require approval and let users redact material or cancel.

remediation.issue: The shell example places user text in a quoted command argument.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured tool call or a shell-free wrapper. Add standard input support so draft text does not appear in process arguments.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads credentials from its environment or a persistent JSON file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a scoped credential from a secret manager or OS keyring. Test fallback file permissions and ensure status and error output never expose secrets.

content.user_title: Check Social Media Drafts for Restricted Wording
content.value_statement: Platform policies vary, and drafts can contain wording that needs review. SocialDataX flags potential issues and suggests revisions before you publish.
actual_capabilities: Reviews submitted draft text through the SocialDataX service.
Supports Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, and a general text mode.
Reports whether the service flagged a violation, along with a risk level and issue categories when available.
Highlights flagged excerpts and summarizes the findings when available.
Returns suggested wording changes when the service provides them.
limitations: Reviews text only and does not analyze images or videos.
A result does not guarantee platform approval or establish legal compliance.
Requires network access and a configured SocialDataX credential or authenticated MCP connection.
SocialDataX stores submitted drafts and results, and checks may use account credits.

use_cases.title: Review a campaign caption
use_cases.description: Check a caption cleared for external review against the intended platform context before scheduling it.

use_cases.title: Revise a flagged phrase
use_cases.description: Use flagged excerpts and suggested wording to revise a draft while preserving its intended meaning.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a manual review
use_cases.description: Use the risk level and issue categories to decide which claims need further review before approval.

prompt_templates.title: Check a short draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this draft, approved for external review, in general text mode: [draft]. Tell me whether the service flagged anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Get a first pass on a short piece of copy.

prompt_templates.title: Review a caption for Xiaohongshu
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this Xiaohongshu caption, approved for external review: [caption]. List the risk level and any flagged phrases.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a caption for a specific platform.

prompt_templates.title: Revise flagged wording
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this Douyin draft, approved for external review: [draft]. Suggest a neutral revision for each flagged phrase without adding new claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn flagged phrases into targeted edits.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare notes for manual review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this Kuaishou draft, approved for external review: [draft]. Group flagged excerpts by issue category. Separate suggested revisions from claims that still need manual verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a review note for a draft with several claims.

output_examples.input: Review this draft product caption for Xiaohongshu: Our workshop guarantees instant results for everyone.
output: Example result: Potential issue flagged. Risk level: medium.
Flagged phrase: guarantees instant results for everyone.
Suggested revision: Our workshop introduces techniques you can practice at your own pace.

output_examples.input: Check this event announcement in general text mode: Registration opens Friday at noon.
output: No revisions were suggested. Confirm the registration time before publishing.

best_practices: Choose the intended platform when it is known.
Confirm external submission is approved and remove unnecessary personal or confidential details.
Review flagged wording in context and verify important claims before publishing.
anti_patterns: Submitting private drafts or credentials in the text to check.
Treating an unflagged result as a guarantee of approval.
Repeating paid checks to troubleshoot a missing credential or a low balance.

faq.question: Which platforms can I check?
faq.answer: Choose Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, or general text mode.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials. Do not paste keys into chat.

faq.question: What happens to the text I submit?
faq.answer: SocialDataX stores submitted text and results for history, billing, and troubleshooting. Submit only text you are authorized to share with the service.

faq.question: Can it review images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It reviews text, including captions, but not the associated media.

faq.question: Does a clean result mean I can publish?
faq.answer: No. The result is advisory. Review the draft against current platform rules and your own editorial requirements.

faq.question: What happens if my account has insufficient credits?
faq.answer: The check stops. Verify your balance through the official SocialDataX dashboard before trying again.
